presets.name: Robot talk
presets.desc: The voice's own melody stepped to the nearest semitone on a saw, words kept clear by flatten and sibilance
presets.notes: No keyboard: the carrier follows the singer. Chromatic quantize gives the robot steps; 24 bands keep vowel onsets within 8 ms

presets.name: Choir of one
presets.desc: A three-part supersaw harmony that follows the singer in the song's key, vowels from the voice
presets.notes: golem sets key / scale per song. The added notes are diatonic thirds and fifths above the sung note

presets.name: Monotone machine
presets.desc: A fixed-pitch buzz an octave down speaks every word: harsh, flat and fully intelligible
presets.notes: Buzz is the flattest carrier; 32 bands for spoken precision (slower vowel onsets: keep it for slow lines)

presets.name: Song-key pad
presets.desc: A vocoded seventh chord in the song key sings under the dry voice; scenes move the degree
presets.notes: Mix 35 % keeps the dry voice in front; golem changes `degree` per scene (verse vi, chorus IV)

presets.name: Hold the ahh
presets.desc: Sing a vowel, stomp freeze: the vowel stays on a supersaw triad while you sing over it
presets.notes: Freeze on a foot switch; the held vowel ignores the gate, the sibilance stays live

presets.name: Whisper
presets.desc: A breathy, pitchless voice: the words imposed on noise, sibilance well up
presets.notes: Good for spoken intros; the noise carrier needs no unvoiced switch

presets.name: Small voice
presets.desc: The voice's formants raised four semitones at the same pitch: a smaller, brighter singer
presets.notes: Few, wide analysis bands follow the formants, not the harmonics. A coarse colour; gfx-formant is the clean shifter

presets.name: Big voice
presets.desc: The voice's formants lowered four semitones at the same pitch: a bigger, darker singer
presets.notes: Sib 0: with Self the pass-through and the top band are the same signal and would comb

presets.name: Synth guitar
presets.desc: Single notes played on a supersaw fifth that follows the guitar, shaped by the pick's attack and decay
presets.notes: Instrument register (75 Hz – 1.5 kHz, harmonic lock); single notes, not chords

presets.name: Strings vocoder
presets.desc: Eleven wide log bands on an ensemble'd triad: the few-band, smeared choir of late-70s keyboard vocoders
presets.notes: Flatten 0 is the vintage carrier × voice response; the 4 dB gaps between bands are part of the sound

presets.name: Robot octaves
presets.desc: The sung note and the octave below on a pulse wave, stepped to semitones: a thick robot lead
presets.notes: The added octave sits under the melody, so the tune stays on top

presets.name: Talking chords
presets.desc: The keys' rhythm and timbre carve a song-key triad drone: the chord speaks with the playing
presets.notes: The keys are the modulator; scenes move `degree` with the progression
